title: Why Composition API?
description: Understand the motivation behind the Composition API and when to use it.

slides.title: The Limitations of Options API
slides.content:
# Options API: Great, but...

The Options API (`data`, `methods`, `computed`, `watch`) is simple for small components. However, as components grow, related logic can become scattered across different options.

```javascript
export default {
  data() { return { searchQuery: '', results: [] } },
  computed: { filteredResults() { ... } },
  watch: { searchQuery() { this.fetchResults() } },
  methods: { fetchResults() { ... } },
  mounted() { this.fetchResults() }
}
```

For a single feature, you jump between `data`, `watch`, `methods`, `mounted`. **Code organization by option type** can hurt readability.

slides.title: Composition API to the Rescue

quizData.question: What is a primary benefit of the Composition API?

options.text: It replaces the Options API entirely
It allows grouping related logic together, improving reusability
It removes the need for reactive data

quizData.explanation: The Composition API helps organize code by logical concern rather than option type, making components easier to understand and reuse.
